name: Concrete

theme.font: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

css: .popover, .popover.sheet { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--docent-fg); } .popover .arrow { border-color: var(--docent-fg) !important; border-width: 2px !important; border-radius: 0 !important; } .title { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.35; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .eyebrow { text-transform: none; letter-spacing: 0; font-size: 11px; } .body { font-size: 13px; color: var(--docent-fg); } .footer { margin-top: 16px; padding-top: 12px; border-top: 2px solid var(--docent-fg); } .count { color: var(--docent-fg); letter-spacing: 0; } .button, .popover.stories [part~='button-next'] { border-radius: 0; } .button { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--docent-fg); font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .button:hover, [part~='button-skip']:hover { background: var(--docent-fg); color: var(--docent-bg); } [part~='button-skip'] { box-shadow: none; } .button.primary { box-shadow: none; } .button.primary:hover { background: oklch(34% 0 0); } .close { border-radius: 0; color: var(--docent-fg); } .close:hover { background: var(--docent-fg); color: var(--docent-bg); }
